description: The file defines the class CalendarSyncConfig which manages configuration settings for calendar synchronization in SuiteCRM. It handles retrieval and persistence of various configuration options, merging defaults with saved values, and provides methods to access specific configuration parameters. The class also interacts with other system components such as SugarConfig and Configurator.

classes.name: CalendarSyncConfig
classes.description: Provides configuration management for Calendar Sync functionality within SuiteCRM, allowing retrieval of default and stored configuration parameters, and updating settings.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all configuration settings merged with defaults.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Saves configuration key-value pairs to the system, handling type casting and cache clearing.

methods.name: getRunAsyncValue
methods.description: Retrieves the boolean value indicating if sync runs asynchronously.

methods.name: getMaxAccountsPerSync
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of accounts to sync per operation.

methods.name: getMaxOperationsPerAccount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of operations per account during synchronization.

methods.name: getSyncWindowPastDays
methods.description: Returns how many days in the past the sync window covers.

methods.name: getSyncWindowFutureDays
methods.description: Returns how many days in the future the sync window covers.

methods.name: getConflictResolution
methods.description: Returns the strategy for conflict resolution during sync.

methods.name: allowInternalEventDeletion
methods.description: Indicates if internal events can be deleted.

methods.name: allowExternalEventDeletion
methods.description: Indicates if external events can be deleted.

methods.name: enableCalendarSyncLogicHooks
methods.description: Determines if calendar sync logic hooks are enabled.

methods.name: getExternalCalendarName
methods.description: Returns the external calendar's name used in syncing.

methods.name: getLastManualRunTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last manual sync run.

methods.name: setLastManualRunTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the last manual sync run.
